children.text: Thank you! I guess I was fed up with lack of clients supporting enough MCP capabilities, so I had to build new one :)
Pretty sweet tool. Happy to see another builder for the MCP world!

children.author: jacooper
children.text: So this turns mcps into cli based clients?

children.author: jauntywundrkind
children.text:
I also ran into https://github.com/philschmid/mcp-cli this morning, which similarly makes a cli out of MCPs. I had been working a little on my own, but here we are!

I see this as a very viable path to "code mode", to having ai write code instead of directly invoking tools. Having the AI write down is work allows nice refinement over time, iteration, in a way that it just calling all the tools directly doesnt yield up. https://blog.cloudflare.com/code-mode/ https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45399204
